violet.sre: RCA for the 07/02 throttling incident is published: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1887654321-throttle-rca. Short: misconfigured cache eviction window + downstream queueing increased tail latency for ~20m. No customer data exposure.
postmortem-bot: Document created by violet.sre: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1887654321-throttle-rca :robot_face:
omar.prod: Thanks Violet. I added a 3-line exec summary and a draft customer note in the doc (Appendix B). Please claim actions.
lucas.eng: I'll take the cache-config revert and add the revert PR link. Will push within the hour.
alia.support: I'll review the customer note and prep the outreach list. ETA tomorrow 09:00 PT.
violet.sre: Quick action list here: 1) Revert cache config + PR link (owner: @lucas.eng) due: today EOD; 2) Alert threshold tuning + runbook update (owner: @omar.prod) due: tomorrow 12:00 PT; 3) Customer outreach draft + approval (owner: @alia.support) due: tomorrow 10:00 PT.
ovar.prod: small correction: I'll own the runbook addition; alert tuning I'll coordinate with SRE.
violet.sre: Noted. Proposing a 20-min follow-up Fri 11:00 PT to close items. React with :thumbsup: if you can.
lucas.eng: +1 Fri 11:00 PT works.
alia.support: +1
omar.prod: +1
